### DC Fire and EMS Department Case Study

For fire crews working in the nation's capital, busy roads and blind corners are a challenge on every run. That's why leaders at DC Fire and EMS department added Safety Cloud protection to their fleet.

Read the full **DC Fire and EMS Department Case Study** to learn how one of the country's largest fire departments used Safety Cloud R2V™ (Responder-to-Vehicle) and R2R™ (Responder-to-Responder) digital alerting to achieve critical objectives, including:

- Preventing collisions and protecting fire crews on the road
- Improving local motorist Move Over compliance and awareness
- Reducing the likelihood of costly responder-on-responder collisions
